newsitem.title: USA: NCAA AMERICAN FOOTBALL-WUERFFEL WINS HEISMAN TROPHY COLLEGE FOOTBALL AWARD.
newsitem.headline: NCAA AMERICAN FOOTBALL-WUERFFEL WINS HEISMAN TROPHY COLLEGE FOOTBALL AWARD.

text.p: University of Florida quarterback Danny Wuerffel won the Heisman Trophy Saturday as the outstanding college football player in the United States.
Wuerffel was presented with the award at the Downtown Athletic Club, which annually hands out the sport's most prestigious individual prize.
He became the second Florida player to win the bronze statue, joining his coach Steve Spurrier, who won in 1966.
Wuerffel received 300 first-place votes and 1,363 points in the nationwide voting. Iowa State junior running back Troy Davis was second with 209 firsts and 1,174 points.
